data.name: Flippin' Heck
data.detailed_description:
Fall into the Abyss. Play Your Way Out.

You are an aspiring pinball designer, yearning to make a name for yourself. You just never can seem to finish any projects you start. You get bored, wander off, or start something else. How can you possibly end this cycle of self-doubt?

It's decided. Tomorrow's the day you turn it all around. Remembering that you've just ordered a basic pinball kit, you start to fall asleep with delusions of grandeur.

Suddenly, the bed gives out under you, and you begin to fall.

You wake up in a dimly lit room, with no escape. It's eerily similar to the room you fell asleep in. There's a pinball table already sitting there, spare parts scattered all over the floor.

What is this place? Why are you trapped in here?

It seems like the only way out for now, is to play.

Master the Machine

Dig around the room, crack its puzzles, find what it's hiding. It all comes back to the pinball table. Launch the ball, land your combos, screw with the machine and watch as the room changes around you.

Summon New Parts

Play to charge your pinballs with mysterious power. Spend it summoning parts and installing them into the table. Every one changes the game. New combos, new mechanics, new stuff to figure out.

Battle Your Demons

This room is your own unfinished ambition made real. Getting out means finally doing the one thing you never could; actually finishing something.

data.short_description: A puzzle-driven pinball escape room. Customize your table with new parts that unlock inventive combos and mechanics, then use them to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and find your way out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz (x86_64)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 or OpenGL 3.3 compatible, 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU, 3.0 GHz (x86_64)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 or OpenGL 3.3 compatible, 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
